verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Identity Verification checks documents, name, date of birth, ID numbers and addresses. It also documents webhooks, Link callbacks, a retry endpoint and Dashboard views of session status and risk. None of it shows an API response that returns the extracted document fields (name, DOB, document number, address, expiry) as structured data. Verifying those fields is a related capability, not proof that the extracted values can be retrieved through the API.

support.subject: As a developer, verified sessions return the extracted document fields as structured data — name, date of birth, document number, address, expiry — retrievable via the API, not just a pass/fail flag
